note: What a server answers a registration with, naming a player in the match and the seat they occupy. It shares its command value with the request it answers, which travels the other way.

fields.name: leading
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. It occupies the same three bytes a request uses, and a server is free to send zeros there.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: Which seat in the match the named player occupies, counted from zero.

fields.name: unknown
fields.note: Purpose undetermined. It spans the bytes a request fills with its version and its proof, and nothing observed reads any of it: a receiving end takes the seat and the player identifier and looks no further.
